1.web: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
1.asv: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

2.web: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
2.asv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

3.web: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
3.asv: And these were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;

4.web: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
4.asv: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.

5.web: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
5.asv: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

6.web: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
6.asv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

7.web: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
7.asv: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

8.web: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
8.asv: And Hakkoz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

9.web: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers: and his mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
9.asv: And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

10.web: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from evil, that it not be to my sorrow!” God granted him that which he requested.
10.asv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it be not to my sorrow! And God granted him that which he requested.

11.web: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
11.asv: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begat Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

12.web: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
12.asv: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

13.web: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
13.asv: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.

14.web: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim; for they were craftsmen.
14.asv: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.

15.web: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.
15.asv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.

16.web: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
16.asv: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

17.web: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she bore Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
17.asv: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

18.web: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
18.asv: And his wife the Jewess bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

19.web: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
19.asv: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

20.web: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
20.asv: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

21.web: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
21.asv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

22.web: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. The records are ancient.
22.asv: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records are ancient.

23.web: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they lived with the king for his work.
23.asv: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

24.web: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
24.asv: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

25.web: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
25.asv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

26.web: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
26.asv: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

27.web: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, neither did all their family multiply like the children of Judah.
27.asv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply like to the children of Judah.

28.web: They lived at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
28.asv: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

29.web: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
29.asv: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

30.web: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
30.asv: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

31.web: and at Beth Marcaboth, and Hazar Susim, and at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities to the reign of David.
31.asv: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

32.web: Their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
32.asv: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

33.web: and all their villages that were around the same cities, to Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
33.asv: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.

34.web: Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
34.asv: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

35.web: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
35.asv: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

36.web: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
36.asv: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

37.web: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
37.asv: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

38.web: these mentioned by name were princes in their families: and their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
38.asv: these mentioned by name were princes in their families: and their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

39.web: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
39.asv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

40.web: They found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for those who lived there before were of Ham.
40.asv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.

41.web: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents, and the Meunim who were found there, and destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
41.asv: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.

42.web: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
42.asv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

43.web: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
43.asv: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and have dwelt there unto this day.
